name: Footprint Function Mechanism
definition: A 2D reconstruction kernel used to implement the 3D spherically symmetric splat kernel by integrating it along one dimension, represented as a pre-computed 2D lookup table.
summary: The Footprint Function Mechanism accelerates volume rendering by pre-computing 3D kernel integrals into a 2D lookup table, replacing expensive per-pixel 3D evaluations with fast 2D table lookups.
